zh.title: 塞爾維亞航空 A319 進場貝爾格勒 商務機轉錯方向後重飛
zh.summary: JU211 航班依塔臺指示重飛，約15分鐘後在貝爾格勒機場平安落地。
body: 據 The Aviation Herald 報導，塞爾維亞航空 JU211 航班11月19日由倫敦希斯洛（LHR）飛往貝爾格勒，執飛客機是註冊號 YU-APA 的空中巴士 A319-100。客機進場12L跑道時，另有一架商務機正在滑行準備離場。
塔臺原許可商務機進入12L跑道排隊等待，但商務機向左轉往相反方向。塔臺隨即要求進場中的 A319 重飛，機組在約1,000英尺高度執行。
商務機離開跑道後回到原等待位置，之後依正確方向進入跑道起飛。JU211 在重飛約15分鐘後，於同一條12L跑道平安降落。

en.title: Air Serbia A319 goes around after business jet turns the wrong way at Belgrade
en.summary: Flight JU211 landed safely about 15 minutes after the tower instructed it to go around.
body: An Air Serbia A319-100 approaching Belgrade from London Heathrow (LHR) went around on November 19, The Aviation Herald reported. Flight JU211 was operated by YU-APA and was approaching runway 12L as a business jet taxied for departure.
The business jet was cleared to line up and wait on runway 12L but turned in the opposite direction. The tower instructed the Air Serbia crew to go around, which the crew began at about 1,000 feet.
The business jet cleared the runway, returned to its holding point and subsequently departed. The A319 landed safely on runway 12L about 15 minutes after the go-around.

facts.claim: The business jet turned the opposite way from its line-up clearance.
The tower instructed flight JU211 to go around.
The A319 landed safely about 15 minutes later.
